arabic_text: مَا أَكَلَ أَحَدٌ طَعَامًا قَطُّ خَيْرًا مِنْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْ عَمَلِ يَدِهِ
english_translation: No one has ever eaten better food than that which he earned by the work of his own hands.
question: What does the Hadith 'مَا أَكَلَ أَحَدٌ طَعَامًا قَطُّ خَيْرًا مِنْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْ عَمَلِ يَدِهِ' emphasize?

options.A: The importance of sharing food with others
options.B: The virtue of eating only halal food
options.C: The superiority of eating from one's own earnings
options.D: The blessing of eating in congregation

question: In which authentic collection of Hadith is this narration about earning one's living found?
